impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Ok(Record::GainChangeForTheLane(x))
        | Ok(Record::PanChangeForTheLane(x))
        | Ok(Record::TrimChangeForTheLane(x)) = control.try_pop()
        {
            self.apply(x);
        }
    }
}
